headline: DoorDash in Advanced Talks to Acquire Instacart for $17 Billion
summary: DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire rival delivery platform Instacart in a transaction that would value the company at roughly $17 billion.
why: Consolidation among major delivery platforms reshapes the competitive landscape of online grocery and restaurant delivery, altering market share dynamics against retail giants like Walmart and Amazon.

impacts.name: DoorDash
impacts.why: A multi-billion dollar acquisition requires significant capital allocation or equity issuance, altering DoorDash's financial structure.

why_moved: A multi-billion-dollar tie-up between two dominant food and grocery delivery platforms fundamentally alters market concentration, drawing immediate attention from arbitrageurs and sector investors.
